search.//: maxAttempts=单请求最多换号数; retryBudgetMs=单请求重试总预算; quietMs=搜索静默收工; maxMs=单路硬超时
search.instruction: You MUST use web search (and X/Twitter search when relevant) to gather the latest, most accurate and up-to-date information before answering. Always search first, then answer based on the search results, and cite your sources in your response.

quota.//: intervalMs=全量刷新周期(毫秒,0=关闭); initialDelayMs=启动后首次刷新延迟; concurrency=刷新并发

content.//: 正文补全：上游只给 500 字节选，这里二次抓取前 maxPages 条整页正文；maxChars=抓取/存储上限，textMaxChars=聊天文本输出上限；render=被反爬拦截时用 FlareSolverr 渲染兜底
